import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(df))

# 1. Price by Brand (Bar chart)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
bars = ax1.bar(df['brand'], df['price_usd'], color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Brand')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax1.set_title('Price by Brand')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar, price in zip(bars, df['price_usd']):
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 50, 
             f'${price:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price (Scatter)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], c=range(len(df)), 
                       cmap='viridis', s=100, edgecolors='black')
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax2.annotate(row['brand'], (row['megapixels'], row['price_usd']), 
                 xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels')
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price')

# 3. Sensor Type Distribution (Pie chart)
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(sensor_counts, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%', 
        colors=sns.color_palette("pastel"), startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution')

# 4. Weight vs Max ISO (Scatter with body type)
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()
body_colors = {'Compact': 'red', 'Mirrorless': 'blue', 'DSLR': 'green'}
for body in body_types:
    subset = df[df['body_type'] == body]
    ax4.scatter(subset['weight_grams'], subset['max_iso'], 
                label=body, s=100, c=body_colors.get(body, 'gray'), edgecolors='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)')
ax4.set_ylabel('Max ISO')
ax4.set_title('Weight vs Max ISO by Body Type')
ax4.legend()

# 5. Model Year Timeline (Horizontal bar)
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
df_sorted = df.sort_values('model_year')
ax5.barh(df_sorted['brand'] + ' (' + df_sorted['model_year'].astype(str) + ')', 
         df_sorted['megapixels'], color=sns.color_palette("coolwarm", len(df)))
ax5.set_xlabel('Megapixels')
ax5.set_title('Camera Evolution: Megapixels by Year')

# 6. Correlation Heatmap
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
numeric_cols = ['model_year', 'megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0, ax=ax6, 
            fmt='.2f', square=True, linewidths=0.5)
ax6.set_title('Feature Correlation')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
